Change c0027. Location: 1818 Letter II; 1831 Letter II.

Context before (unchanged): I dare not expect such success, yet I cannot bear to look on the reverse of the picture.

1818 text: Continue to write to me by every opportunity: I may receive your letters (though the chance is very doubtful) on some occasions when I need them most to support my spirits.

1831 text: Continue for the present to write to me by every opportunity: I may receive your letters on some occasions when I need them most to support my spirits.

Diff: Continue {+for the present+} to write to me by every opportunity: I may receive your letters [-(though the chance is very doubtful)-] on some occasions when I need them most to support my spirits.

Context after (unchanged): I love you very tenderly.

result.rationale: Adds "for the present" and cuts the parenthetical "(though the chance is very doubtful)". Walton's hope of contact becomes less qualified and more time-bound, shifting his tone toward confidence rather than isolation.
